question.text: Complete client onboarding by a Portfolio Manager offering discretionary services includes:

answer.text: Providing the Disclosure Document and MITC to the client, completing KYC/PAN/application, and entering into a signed PMS agreement

explanation.text: The Logic: Complete onboarding requires the Portfolio Manager to provide the Disclosure Document and the Most Important Terms and Conditions (MITC) to the client before the agreement is signed, complete mandatory KYC and PAN verification along with the application, and then execute a written PMS agreement covering bank and demat details. The Trap: KYC alone, PAN alone, or oral consent is insufficient — the workbook requires the full set of documents and a signed agreement. Note: Stem reworded so that the Disclosure Document and MITC are described as provided to (not obtained from) the client.
